CorrectiveAction.name: Clear error C0330 until hand conditions are set
CorrectiveAction.description: Clear error C0330 from the teaching pendant or RT ToolBox3 until the hand conditions are set.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. Clear the error from the teaching pendant or RT ToolBox3 until the hand conditions are set.

CorrectiveAction.name: Set hand conditions using HNDDAT
CorrectiveAction.description: Set the hand conditions using parameter HNDDAT.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. Set the hand conditions using the parameter HNDDAT* (* = 0 to 8).

CorrectiveAction.name: Move in the counter direction
CorrectiveAction.description: Move the robot in the counter direction when the T/B buzzer sounds and the robot does not move.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. If the T/B buzzer sounds and the robot does not move, move in the counter direction.

CorrectiveAction.name: Move robot to position where linear movement is possible
CorrectiveAction.description: Move the robot to a position where linear movement is possible, then carry out XYZ jog.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. Move the robot to a position where linear movement is possible, and then carry out XYZ jog.

CorrectiveAction.name: Contact the manufacturer
CorrectiveAction.description: Contact the manufacturer regarding the detected fault.

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace with a new part or take remedial measures
CorrectiveAction.description: Replace the affected part with a new part or take remedial measures.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. Replace with a new part, or take remedial measures.

CorrectiveAction.name: Check gasket is in place
CorrectiveAction.description: Ensure the gasket is correctly installed when reinstalling the cover.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. Type A: Insert the gasket into the groove. Type B: The gasket is attached to the base cover. Check that the gasket is in place.

CorrectiveAction.name: Refer to troubleshooting, check and remedy positional deviation
CorrectiveAction.description: If positional deviation cannot be corrected, refer to troubleshooting to check and remedy the issue.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. If the positional deviation cannot be corrected, refer to "Troubleshooting", check and remedy.

CorrectiveAction.name: Install robot on level surface
CorrectiveAction.description: Install the robot on a level surface.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. Install the robot on a level surface.

CorrectiveAction.name: Use recommended table surface roughness
CorrectiveAction.description: Use a table with the recommended surface roughness for installation.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. It is recommended that the surface roughness of the table onto which the robot is to be installed by 6.3 Ra or more.

CorrectiveAction.name: Set hand condition parameters
CorrectiveAction.description: Set the initial condition of the hand.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. Set the initial condition of the hand. 2. Specify with the tool coordinate system. 3. Set weight, size X, size Y, size Z, center of gravity X, center of gravity Y, center of gravity Z. 4. Set the hand and workpiece conditions correctly.

CorrectiveAction.name: Overhaul before specified servo-on time
CorrectiveAction.description: Carry out overhaul before the total servo-on time reaches the specified time.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. Carry out overhaul before the total amount of servo-on time reaches the specified time. 2. Use 36,000 hours for the robot arm as the specified time. 3. Use 36,000 hours for the controller as the specified time.

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace parts during overhaul
CorrectiveAction.description: Replace parts reaching the end of their specified service life so that the robots may be restored for continued use.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. Replace parts running out of specified service life. 2. Put the robots back in shape for continued use.

CorrectiveAction.name: Release brake using emergency power supply
CorrectiveAction.description: Procedure for releasing the brake using the emergency power supply in an emergency.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: 1. Connect the teaching pendant to the robot controller. 2. Connect the 24V DC power supply to EXT1 of the controller as shown in the figure below. 3. To prevent accidental power supply from the primary power supply of the robot, prepare an emergency power supply system separated from the primary power supply of the robot to supply AC power to the 24V DC power supply. 4. When the 24V DC power supply is turned on, the controller starts and then errors (H0712, H0090, H0212) will occur. 5. Use the teaching pendant or RT VisualBox to release the brakes.
